blurb: Members can walk on, enjoy boating, and walk off with no ownership hassle. The club offers unlimited free training with licensed captains and handles all maintenance, cleaning, insurance, and storage. Membership includes access to 450+ locations across North America, Europe, and Australia.
extraNote: One-time initiation fee plus straightforward monthly dues · No hidden costs · 21 marinas across the Boston area including Seaport, Charlestown, East Boston, Quincy, Beverly, Hingham, Plymouth, South Shore, and Cape Cod locations

quotes.text: Joining Freedom Boat Club has been one of my best decisions. They have some of the best staff that are always ready to help. Thank you, Nicole, Olivia, Huge, Mike and everyone else that has made this such a wonderful experience.

A close friend has a membership and we got there and within a few minutes all of us were already cruising in the harbor. This really confirmed what Freedom Club advertises when it comes to the simplicity and ease of use.
Freedom Boat Club Charlestown has the best staff. They are very responsive, helpful and knowledgeable. We love it here
